Messages.Author: Matthew E Strehlow
Messages.Body:
If you block a Bum's Rush is the maneuver canceled?

What effects can you do during a Bloodhunt? ie can you tap Ventrue
Headquarters, The Masoleum, burn a vote card. I'm pretty sure you can't
play reaction or action modifier cards because no Vampire is calling the
action.

Thanks,
~Matt Strehlow

Messages.Author: corr...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
In article <38AA357A...@students.wisc.edu>,

Matthew E Strehlow <mestr...@students.wisc.edu> wrote:
> If you block a Bum's Rush is the maneuver canceled?

Yes, because the action has canceled and the maneuver is lost for the
effect of the block.

> What effects can you do during a Bloodhunt? ie can you tap Ventrue
> Headquarters, The Masoleum, burn a vote card. I'm pretty sure you
can't
> play reaction or action modifier cards because no Vampire is calling
> the action.

The effects that can you do are: tap VH, the Masoleum. The effect of
burn a vote card is if you call the Bloodhunt, and respect to play
cards ie. reactions cards this no count in this vote.

SETH

Messages.Author: davey!
Messages.Body:
On Wed, 16 Feb 2000 corr...@my-deja.com wrote:

> The bloodhunt is considered a political action.

no it's not - after all, who's taking the action?

but it is referendum.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Correct. It is not an action (therefore, not a political action)
and cannot be blocked, modified with action modifiers or reacted
to with reaction cards.

It is a referendum, though, so a Methuselah can burn a Political
Action card from her hand for a vote and can burn the Edge for
a vote, etc.
